findings.evidence: Lines 231-243 declare only `mixed_obj`, `Faithful`, `Additive`, `Linear`; no lemma mentions `mixed.map`.
findings.fix: Add `mixed_map_hom : HEq (mixed.map f) f` plus the `eqToHom`-conjugated `mixed_map`, mirroring lines 256-267.
findings.issue: `mixed` gets only `mixed_obj` (line 233); its action on morphisms is uncharacterized, unlike `rational` (`rational_map_hom`/`rational_map`, lines 256, 264) and `complex` (lines 293, 301). With the body unexposed, a consumer cannot state or prove anything about `mixed.map f`, so the mixed realization is unusable for transporting the existing `MixedHodgeStructureCat` kernel/strictness/subobject API (Mixed/Kernels.lean, Mixed/CoimageImage.lean) to this category.

findings.evidence: Line 227 `map f := f`; lines 236-237 give `Faithful` only; the repo already uses `Full`/`FullyFaithful` instances (Topology/Covering/Monodromy/Full.lean:42).
findings.fix: Add the `(mixed (n := n)).Full` instance (`⟨fun f ↦ ⟨f, rfl⟩⟩`), or better a `Functor.FullyFaithful` def as done for `fullyFaithfulForget` in TauCeti/Topology/Covering/Monodromy/Connected.lean:119.
findings.issue: `mixed` is fully faithful by construction (`map f := f`, line 227, since `Hom X Y` is reducibly `MixedHodgeStructure.Hom X.asMixed.hs Y.asMixed.hs`), but only `Faithful` is declared. Fullness is exactly what identifies subobjects/simple objects here with the mixed ones for the L1 semisimplicity target, and the unexposed body makes it unprovable downstream.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/Geometry/Hodge/Projection.lean:102 `HodgeStructureOn.IsMorphism hs hs (rationalMapToComplex hℚ hℂ hℚ hℂ (projection P W))`, and lines 120/136 state the semisimplicity-in-projector-form results in the same shape.
findings.fix: Add `Hom.ofIsMorphism (f : X.ratCarrier →ₗ[ℚ] Y.ratCarrier) (h : HodgeStructureOn.IsMorphism X.hs Y.hs (rationalMapToComplex … f)) : Hom X Y` with its `toRatLinearMap` simp lemma (or take that hypothesis in `mk`).
findings.issue: Introduction and elimination speak different languages: `Hom.mk` takes the elementwise hypothesis `∀ p x, x ∈ X.hs.F p → rationalMapToComplex … f x ∈ Y.hs.F p`, while `Hom.isMorphism` (line 167) returns `HodgeStructureOn.IsMorphism`, which is also the exact form every existing producer of rational Hodge morphisms yields. Building an object-level morphism from a Hodge projector therefore requires hand-converting `map_F_le` back to membership form.

summary: The `mixed` realization has no characteristic lemma for its action on morphisms and no fullness instance, and since its body is unexposed downstream can supply neither. The morphism introduction `Hom.mk` is also phrased in a different vocabulary from both the elimination `Hom.isMorphism` and every existing producer in the repo.
